# Thermal Science

> > Thermal Science is a peer-reviewed scientific journal published by the Society of Thermal Engineers of Serbia, covering research in heat transfer, thermodynamics, combustion, renewable energy, and fluid mechanics.

Founded and edited by Simeon Oka at the Vinča Institute of Nuclear Sciences in Serbia, the journal publishes original research papers, special issues, and supplements on thermal engineering topics. The journal is indexed in Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar, and CrossRef, serving as an international platform for thermal science research.

## Key Topics

- Heat transfer and mass transfer
- Thermodynamic analysis and entropy methods
- Renewable and sustainable energy systems
- Combustion and biomass co-combustion
- Nanofluids and heat exchangers
- Refrigeration machines and heat pumps
- Turbulent flows and CFD simulation
- Boundary layer analysis
- Energy efficiency and irreversibility
- Internal combustion engines
- Solar energy applications
- Porous media and fluid mechanics
- Fire science and thermal degradation

## Research Papers - Heat Transfer & Thermodynamics

- [Entropy-cycle method for analysis of refrigeration machine and heat pump cycles](https://thermalscience.rs/2006/1/11): Paper by Morosuk et al. on entropy-cycle method for refrigeration analysis
- [Performance evaluation of tube-in-tube heat exchangers with heat transfer enhancement in the annulus](https://thermalscience.rs/2006/1/6): Paper by Zimparov et al. on tube-in-tube heat exchanger performance
- [Instability of two rotating viscoelastic (Walters B') superposed fluids with suspended particles in porous medium](https://thermalscience.rs/2007/1/7): Paper by Kumar & Singh on Rayleigh-Taylor instability in viscoelastic fluids

## Research Papers - Combustion & Materials

- [Slagging and fouling in biomass co-combustion](https://thermalscience.rs/2005/3/7): Paper by Tortosa-Masia et al. on deposit formation in biomass combustion
- [The effect of long term exposure to elevated temperature on steam line steel properties](https://thermalscience.rs/2003/1/3): Paper by Zrilić & Aleksić on steam line steel degradation at high temps

## Research Papers - Computational Fluid Dynamics

- [HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPUTING: APPLICATIONS TO THE NUMERICAL SIMULATION OF TURBULENT FLOWS](https://thermalscience.rs/2001/1/3): Paper by Breuer et al. on HPC for turbulent flow simulation at LSTM

## Editorial Content

- [From the Editor-in-Chief, issue 2007/4](https://thermalscience.rs/2007/4/0): Editorial by Simeon Oka on journal anniversary and achievements
- [From the guest editors](https://thermalscience.rs/2008/1/14): Guest editorial by Stojiljković & Petrović on transport energy issues
